summary: --type container creates a Container Enabled role with tailored defaults such as a different README, a .travis.yml using Ansible Container and meta/container.yml.
questions: How do I create a container enabled role?
What does ansible-galaxy role init --type container add?

answer_card.title: Create a Container Enabled role
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
ansible-galaxy role init --type container role_name
```
Same layout as a normal role but with container defaults: a different README structure, a `.travis.yml` that tests with Ansible Container, and `meta/container.yml`.
